EmailTemplate.description: Sent automatically when an Individual Application is submitted and the Application Status is set to Applied.
EmailTemplate.name: HS Application Submission Confirmation
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for Applying to Zeta!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {{{IndividualApplication.Parent_Guardian_1_First_Name__c}}} {{{IndividualApplication.Parent_Guardian_1_Last_Name__c}}},
Thank you for applying to Zeta High School!
We are so excited that {{{IndividualApplication.fxApplicant_First_Name__c}}} is considering Zeta High, and we look forward to being with you through the next steps of the process.
Log in here < https://myportal.zetaschools.org/s/login/SelfRegister > to view your application.
At Zeta High, students discover their purpose, pursue their passions, and build the power to shape their future. Through rigorous academics, personalized guidance, and real-world experiences, students prepare for college and a life of their own choosing.
Zeta High students benefit from:
- Advanced and AP coursesthat challenge them to reach their highest potential - Free SAT preparation, SAT School Day, and one-on-one college advising - A dedicated Z Coachand close-knit Z Housethat provide guidance and belonging - Hands-on learning through Z Lab, internships, and Z Journeys - Opportunities to explore their interests through Z Teams, Z Clubs, sports, and the arts - A tuition-free public charter educationopen to all students
As Zeta's Enrollment Team, we will be your main point of contact from here on out. We will share important updates, key dates, and opportunities to get to know Zeta High better. We are always here for your questions, big or small.
Sign up for a tour < https://zetaschools.org/events-for-prospective-families/ > to experience Zeta High yourself.
🎥 Our students are waiting for you! < https://www.instagram.com/reels/DS5uEsjDBg0/ >
We can't wait to continue this journey with you and your family.
Warmly,
The Zeta Enrollment Team
Zeta Charter Schools
Please reach out if you have any questions about Zeta, our Enrollment Team is here for you every step of the way:
